primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-derived-lower-shriek-bounded (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3790-3807

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: for torsion Lambda reduce by construction to open immersions (j_! exact, N = 0) and to proper morphisms (Rf_! = Rf_* a right derived functor: left bound from negative vanishing, cohomological dimension of f_* from the finite type and proper cases, conclusion via the unbounded right derived functor lemma); for arbitrary Lambda on D^+_tors again reduce to the proper case, part (1) is immediate, part (3) follows by induction on b - a using truncation triangles and the proper cohomological dimension lemma, and part (2) follows from part (3) (source lines 3809-3836)
